QuestInfo.name: Midas's Touch
QuestInfo.0: Is it true that #b#p2060005##k of #b#m230000000##k became very rich through Diligence? Ask #p2060005#.
QuestInfo.1: #p2060005# explains that he became Diligent by raising animals for a long time. He wants you to make something for him, since you look pretty Diligent yourself...\n\n#i1152030# #t1152030# #b#c1152030# / 1#k

0.0: Hello, welcome to the #m230000000# zoo! Enjoy seeing all the exotic animals! Huh? They say I became rich through Diligence, huh? Come on now, that can't be true!
0.1: I learned Diligence by taking care of the animals. And I do make saddles for people who need them, but that doesn't bring in as much money as you'd think. You look pretty Diligent, though. Maybe you can do me a favor?

yes.0: I hear that especially Diligent craftsmen can make equipment for your shoulders. Think you can do this? I'd like you to make me a  #b#t1152030##k. Please? With your Diligence, I bet it'll be a breeze for you.

no.0: Oh...you can't? That's too bad. I don't think anyone else can do it...

1.0: Whoa! Let me see..amazing! It's so cool! You've got #t1142277#!

item.0: Still working on the #b#t1152030##k? I guess it isn't easy...
